description: This file defines the TransformerConfig struct and associated functions for managing transformation configurations in kustomize, including default config creation, merging, and field management.

classes.name: TransformerConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration data for Kubernetes resource transformations, including fields for prefixes, suffixes, labels, annotations, references, images, and replicas.

methods.name: MakeEmptyConfig
methods.description: Returns a new, empty TransformerConfig object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TransformerConfig instance.

methods.name: MakeDefaultConfig
methods.description: Returns a default TransformerConfig, initialized once and reused.

methods.name: MakeTransformerConfig
methods.description: Merges a default config with custom configs loaded from specified paths.

methods.name: sortFields
methods.description: Sorts the fields within TransformerConfig for determinism.

methods.name: AddPrefixFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a FieldSpec to the NamePrefix slice.

methods.name: AddSuffixFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a FieldSpec to the NameSuffix slice.

methods.name: AddCommonLabelsFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a FieldSpec to the CommonLabels slice.

methods.name: AddLabelsFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a FieldSpec to the Labels slice.

methods.name: AddAnnotationFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a FieldSpec to the CommonAnnotations slice.

methods.name: AddNamereferenceFieldSpec
methods.description: Adds a NameBackReferences to the NameReference slice.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another TransformerConfig into the current one, combining fields.
